content.summary: An international runway model with eighteen years in fashion — from children's presentations in Houston to New York Fashion Week, couture and bridal runways, and an intentional expansion into Dubai.
content.body:
Emma Garces works independently across runway, couture, bridal and editorial — from New York Fashion Week to couture presentations in Houston, with Paris Fashion Week and editorial work in France, and virtual participation in Milan.

Eighteen years after her first runway, she is expanding toward Dubai and international representation.

content.summary: Eighteen years, from a child on a Houston runway to independent international work.
content.body:
Emma was four years old the first time someone suggested she model. Her mother was a stay-at-home mom, and the two of them spent their days exploring Houston. A manager noticed how tall she was for her age and suggested she model the children's collection. That led to her first runway show — bright lights, real nerves, and a walk that felt like arriving somewhere.

Around thirteen, modeling stopped being something that happened to her and became something she pursued. Agency work, castings, and the beginning of a portfolio.

In 2019, while still in her teens, she traveled to France for Paris Fashion Week and fashion editorial work at Château d'Angers. Her first international work.

In September 2021 she walked Negris LeBrum's Spring/Summer 2022 collection in New York. It became the longest working relationship of her career — more than ten projects with the house across New York and Houston, on the runway and in editorial.

The work since has moved across registers — couture and bridal, runway and editorial, in New York and in Houston. She is still walking, and Dubai is next.

content.summary: A working model, a cybersecurity student, and a co-founder.
content.body:
Emma is completing a Bachelor of Science in Cybersecurity and Information Assurance, and holds an Associate degree in Business and Management Administration.

She is Co-Founder of HARFT AI, where her work spans AI operations, platform implementation, cybersecurity, risk reduction and business operations.

She approaches a booking the way she approaches a system: what is the objective, what does the team need, and what could prevent the best result. Both, as she puts it, require preparation, communication, accountability, creative thinking, and the confidence to solve problems in real time.

content.summary: Arriving fifteen minutes early means arriving on time.
content.body:
Emma prepares the night before — a model bag with several colours and heights of heel, nude and black foundations, strapless support, covers, wipes, water, snacks. A designer may add a second or third look at the last minute; without the right foundation or shoe, the garment cannot go out.

In rehearsal she stays quiet and listens, because the stage director may not repeat the instruction. If someone else becomes confused, she holds the original direction rather than copying the mistake.

She treats every garment as a piece of art entrusted to her. Once dressed, she does not eat, does not sit unnecessarily, and takes care of anything she needs beforehand. If there is a problem with a garment she tells the dresser immediately rather than trying to fix it herself.

She treats every designer, photographer, dresser, stylist and technician the same regardless of how established they are. No number of shows or Fashion Weeks makes one person more important than another.

content.summary: Dubai is the next chapter of an international career, not the beginning of one.
content.body:
Emma's international work began in France in 2019 and continued through New York Fashion Week and virtual participation in Milan. She is now focused on Dubai, Middle Eastern designers and the Gulf luxury market, with bridal and haute couture as her strongest registers.

She is available for international travel and extended bookings, and is seeking agency representation and paid international assignments.

content.summary: Houston and New York primary. Available internationally, including extended bookings and travel.
content.body: Primary markets: Houston and New York. Available internationally for runway, couture, bridal, editorial and campaign work, including extended bookings and international travel. Currently seeking representation and paid international assignments, with a particular focus on Dubai and the Gulf.
